verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LangSmith can be hosted in your own infrastructure. The self-hosted instance covers observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering, keeps trace and operational data in your environment, and can optionally add LangSmith Deployment, with Helm configuration guidance for self-hosted Agent Server scaling. One community comment says a cloud account is needed to see traces, but it reflects the default hosted path and does not concretely show self-hosting failing. missing for 10: installation/licensing and availability terms (e.g., whether self-hosting requires an enterprise plan), independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
